name: 32880-oversubscribed-30ba3b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, bf16 unquantized -- not the FP8 sibling, which refuses to launch at TP8 because block_n 128 does not divide moe_intermediate_size 768 (96 per rank). Present in the local HF cache; nothing downloads at run time.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8, EP off, PP=1, DP=1, no DP attention. 4 KV heads do not shard eight ways, so every rank replicates a single KV head and carries the full 24 KiB/token of bf16 KV.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30B total / ~3B active: 48 layers, hidden 2048, GQA with 32 query and 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 routed experts at top-8, moe_intermediate_size 768, context 262144. ~60 GB of bf16 weights, ~7.5 GB per rank at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256 against an admission ceiling of 128, warmup the first 25% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix. 256 prompt tokens in, fixed at exactly that (stdev omitted, which is how guidellm expresses a constant). Out: 900 tokens with stdev 58, floored at 800 and capped at 1000. guidellm attaches max_completion_tokens and ignore_eos to every request and the pinned engine honours both, so the requested length is the delivered length.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 30B expert model across eight GPUs, 256 users sending short prompts.
launch:
# sglang server flags. Flat `key: value` only -- the config reader skips indented lines, so a
# nested block silently disappears and the server starts without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 8
max-running-requests: 128
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
max-prefill-tokens: 16384

# The engine's own derived static fraction for a 16384-token chunk on an 80 GB card, written out
# so a device-memory probe cannot resize the KV pool from run to run.
mem-fraction-static: 0.66

# Do not add `--disable-overlap-schedule`: the prefill delayer requires overlap scheduling and the
# server will not start without it. Overlap is on by default.
enable-prefill-delayer: true
